title: 9: Jenkins CI/CD Workflow
subtitle: Troubleshoot a failed Java build, verify Jenkins pipeline configuration, rerun the Student API CI/CD pipeline, and inspect the successful output.

steps.title: Review Student.java before CI troubleshooting
steps.why: Jenkins failure ni investigate cheyyadaniki mundu developer latest Student.java change ni IntelliJ lo review chestadu. Build failure code change tho related aa ani context establish avuthundi.

steps.title: Open failed build #41

steps.title: Configure the CI trigger
steps.why: Repository changes regular ga validate avvadaniki Jenkins cron trigger ni configure chestam. Simulator scheduling state ni preserve chestundi.

steps.title: Use Jenkinsfile from source control
steps.why: Pipeline definition application repo tho version control lo undali. Jenkinsfile script path ni SCM-based pipeline ga configure chestam.

steps.title: Update the Java Jenkinsfile
steps.why: Build, unit test, integration test, packaging mariyu QA deployment stages ni Jenkinsfile lo define chestam. CI workflow code laga versioned ga untundi.

steps.title: Start build #42 for QA
